title: Medication reminder app
summary: Reminds patients to take medication and tracks adherence.
whyItFails: Free alternatives. Phone alarms work fine. Hard to monetise. Patients won't pay and payers are slow. Engagement. People ignore notifications.
whatWouldChange: Value-based care contracts that pay for measured adherence improvements.

attempts.notes: Online pharmacy that pre-sorted doses to help people take medication on time; bought for a reported $753 million.
NPS MedicineWise's Australian app for tracking medicines.

reasons.detail: Free alternatives: Phone alarms work fine.
Hard to monetise: Patients won't pay and payers are slow.
